key_insight: SP-HQAOA combines hierarchical decomposition with symmetry-preserving contraction to optimize problems larger than the qubit limit using shallow quantum circuits.
engineering_relevance: The approach separates subproblem size from hardware qubit capacity while preserving the zero-field Ising objective through successive contractions.
method: Divide the problem into blocks and recursively merge their solutions.
Contract parity sectors while preserving zero-field Ising structure, with at most Q qubits per quantum call even for blocks larger than Q.
Bound potential optimal-value loss from sector restrictions and accumulate these bounds across the hierarchy.
evidence_signal: At depth p=1, SP-HQAOA reaches 99.4–99.7% of the exact optimum on N=40 random regular MaxCut leaf blocks and 96% of a classical reference for N=500 using at most 10 qubits per circuit.
watch_item: Sector restrictions can exclude better solutions; the reported benchmarks do not establish practical quantum advantage or robustness on noisy hardware.
paper_title: Symmetry-Preserving Hierarchical Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm with Subproblems Beyond the Qubit Limit
